title: SiteProfile
description: A site profile's manifest, profile.yaml (10B-6, commitment C-6, D-1233): one hospital's habits as data. Schema version 1.0.0. Nothing secret and no patient data: credentials stay in the environment, the site's name and addresses in settings, everything per study in the study package.

format.description: The manifest's format; a reader refuses a format it does not know

id.description: The profile's name. A profile shipped in the repository is synthetic and its id starts with synthetic-

site_id.description: settings.site.id of the box this profile is for; a night of another site refuses it

country.description: The country layer above this profile (commitment C-7, card 10C-25); tb_common.site_country.COUNTRIES

version.description: The steward's version of this profile, MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH; changed content needs a new version

synthetic.description: True for a profile of synthetic data (every profile in the repository)

door.description: The data source this profile describes: settings.data_source.type

standards.description: The standard versions the site writes and this profile targets, e.g. {ssmix2: '1.2h', jp_core: '1.1.0'} (names: lower-case letters, digits and _, checked by tb_common.site_profile)

data_types.description: The data types the site's source stores (an SS-MIX2 data type such as ADT-00, or a source table of a csv door). The coverage lines count each one on every night

tables.description: The site's code tables, by name. Each is a CSV in codes/ (or, for a synthetic profile, a file shipped in the image's mapping folder, written shipped:<path>) with a state on every row (names: lower-case letters, digits and _, checked by tb_common.site_profile)

file.description: codes/<name>.csv inside the profile folder, or shipped:<path under services/adapter/mapping> for a synthetic profile

key.description: The column holding the site's own code

target.description: The column holding the standard code it maps to

state.description: The column holding each row's state, verified or verify (default: state)

source.description: Where the rows came from (the hospital's master and its date, a public release, synthetic)

used_by.description: Where the product reads this table: mapping.<look-up> replaces the site mapping's look-up of that name (the mapping must declare it); ssmix2.diagnosis, ssmix2.drug and ssmix2.lab are the SS-MIX2 reader's 病名 to ICD-10, YJ to ATC and known-lab-code tables
